questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा भाषा वर्ग भारत में सबसे छोटा है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following language groups is the smallest in India?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Sanskrit, Bodo, and Manipuri. This language group represents the smallest linguistic demographic in India compared to the other groups listed, which consist of major scheduled languages with significantly larger numbers of speakers.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन वस्तुओं के निर्माताओं से संपर्क करके अपने निर्देशानुसार उत्पादों को बनवाकर अत्यधिक मितव्ययता से व्यापारिक माल खरीद पाते हैं ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following is able to purchase merchandise more economically, by contacting the manufacturers to produce the goods according to their specification?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Chain Stores. Chain stores have the capacity to place large-scale orders directly with manufacturers, often specifying product requirements, which allows them to achieve economies of scale and purchase goods more economically than smaller retailers.

questions.text: कृत्रिम रेशे और प्लास्टिक विनिर्माण निम्नलिखित में से किसका उदाहरण है ?
questions.text_english: Synthetic fibre and plastic manufacturing is an example of which one of the following?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Chemical-based industry. Synthetic fibres and plastics are derived from petrochemical products and involve complex chemical synthesis processes, placing them firmly in the chemical-based industry category.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित युग्मों में से कौन-सा सही सुमेलित है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following pairs is matched correctly?

options.A: पर्वतीय क्षेत्र विकास कार्यक्रम : भारत के शुष्क और अर्धशुष्क क्षेत्र
options.B: सूखा संभावी क्षेत्र कार्यक्रम : 15 पर्वतीय जिले
options.C: इंदिरा गांधी नहर कमान क्षेत्र : गंगानगर, हनुमानगढ़
options.D: समन्वित जनजातीय विकास कार्यक्रम : राजस्थान और गुजरात

options_english.A: Hill Area Development Programme : Semi-arid and Arid tracts of India
options_english.B: Drought Prone Area Programme : 15 Hilly Districts
options_english.C: Indira Gandhi Canal Command Area : Ganganagar, Hanumangarh
options_english.D: Integrated Tribal Development Project : Rajasthan and Gujarat

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C). The Indira Gandhi Canal Command Area is specifically known for its impact on districts like Ganganagar and Hanumangarh in Rajasthan, making this the correctly matched pair among the options provided.

questions.text: राष्ट्रीय कौशल विकास तथा उद्यमिता नीति (2015) के उद्देश्यों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : I. भारत में विभिन्न आयु वर्गों की साक्षरता दर में सुधार करना; II. सभी कौशल से संबंधित गतिविधियों के लिए रूपरेखा प्रदान करना; III. सभी कौशल गतिविधियों को एक मानक के साथ बाँधे रखना; IV. कौशल गतिविधियों को इनके माँग केंद्रों से जोड़ना
questions.text_english: Read the objectives regarding National Policy for Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (2015) carefully and choose the most appropriate option: I. To improve the literacy rate of different age groups in India; II. To provide umbrella framework to all skilling activities; III. To align all skilling activities to common standards; IV. To link skilling activities with demand centres.

options.A: केवल I, II और III सही हैं
options.B: केवल II, III और IV सही हैं
options.C: केवल I, III और IV सही हैं
options.D: केवल I, II और IV सही हैं

options_english.A: Only I, II and III are correct
options_english.B: Only II, III and IV are correct
options_english.C: Only I, III and IV are correct
options_english.D: Only I, II and IV are correct

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B). The National Policy for Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (2015) focused on creating a framework (II), setting common standards (III), and linking skills to demand centers (IV). Improving literacy (I) is a broader educational goal rather than a direct objective of this specific policy.

questions.text: 'वर्षा निर्भर कृषि' का दूसरा नाम क्या है ?
questions.text_english: What is the other name of 'Rainfed type of farming'?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Barani. In the Indian context, farming that depends entirely on rainfall rather than irrigation systems is traditionally known as Barani farming.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा नमामि गंगे कार्यक्रम का उद्देश्य नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following is not the objective of Namami Gange Programme?

options.A: शहरों में सीवर ट्रीटमेंट की व्यवस्था करना
options.C: नदी के किनारों पर वनीकरण करना
options.D: शहरों से नदी के बहाव को मोड़ना

options_english.A: Developing sewerage treatment systems in towns
options_english.C: Afforestation along the banks of the river
options_english.D: To divert the flow of the river from the cities

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D). The Namami Gange program focuses on conservation, pollution abatement, and rejuvenation of the river Ganga, not on diverting its natural flow away from cities.

questions.text: राष्ट्रीय जलमार्ग नं. 1 के विस्तार से संबंधित सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Choose the correct option regarding the stretch of National Waterways No. 1:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). National Waterway No. 1 (NW-1) spans the Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly river system between Allahabad (Prayagraj) and Haldia.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : कथन I : भारत में स्वतंत्रता प्राप्ति के पश्चात महानगरों के चारों ओर कुछ पुराने नगर अनुषंगी नगरों के रूप में विकसित हुए । कथन II : दिल्ली इस प्रकार के महानगरों का अच्छा उदाहरण है ।
questions.text_english: Study the following statements carefully and choose the correct option: Statement I: In India, after independence, some old towns around metropolitan cities developed as satellite towns. Statement II: Delhi is a good example of such metropolitan cities.

options.C: कथन I और II दोनों सही हैं और कथन II, कथन I का सही उदाहरण है
options.D: कथन I और II दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु कथन II, कथन I का सही उदाहरण नहीं है

options_english.C: Both statements I and II are correct and statement II is the correct example of statement I
options_english.D: Both statements I and II are correct, but statement II is not the correct example of statement I

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C). Both statements are factually correct. Delhi represents a major metropolitan center around which several satellite towns (like Noida, Gurgaon, Ghaziabad) have developed following independence, serving as an appropriate example.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा राजस्थान में गुच्छित बस्ती के उद्भव का एक कारण है ? सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Which one of the following is a reason for the emergence of clustered settlements in Rajasthan? Choose the most appropriate option.

options.A: भू-संसाधनों के अधिकतम उपयोग के लिए
options.B: बाह्य रक्षा एवं सुरक्षा के लिए
options.C: उपलब्ध जल स्रोतों का अधिकतम उपयोग करने के लिए
options.D: आंतरिक रक्षा एवं सुरक्षा के लिए

options_english.A: For the maximum utilization of land resources
options_english.C: For maximum utilization of available water resources

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C). In arid regions like Rajasthan, the scarcity of water makes clustered settlements essential around limited water sources to ensure equitable access and survival.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा देश में सबसे बड़ा सरकारी उपक्रम है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following is the biggest government undertaking in the country?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Indian Railways. It is widely recognized as the largest employer and the biggest government-run public sector undertaking in India.

questions.text: भारत के खनन नगरों से संबंधित सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Choose the correct option regarding mining towns of India:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B). Ankaleshwar (oil/gas), Singrauli (coal), and Digboi (oil) are classic examples of mining towns in India, distinct from port, manufacturing, or academic towns.

questions.text: दिए गए कथन को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्न का उत्तर लिखिए : “अधिकांश औद्योगिक अपशिष्ट बहते हुए जल या झीलों में डाल दिया जाता है।” निम्नलिखित में से उद्योगों का कौन-सा वर्ग जल प्रदूषण का प्रमुख स्रोत है? सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Read the given statement carefully and answer the question that follows: "Most of the industrial wastes are disposed off in running water or lakes." Which among the following group of industries are the major source of water pollution? Choose the most appropriate option.

options.D: सूती कपड़ा, रसायन और ऊर्जा संयंत्र

options_english.D: Cotton textile, chemical and power plant

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). Leather, pulp, and paper industries involve highly polluting chemical processes that generate significant toxic liquid waste, which is a major contributor to water pollution when disposed of improperly.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित संगठनों में से कौन-सा अपने सदस्य देशों के लिए वैश्विक व्यापार नियम निर्धारित करता है ? सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Which of the following organisations sets the rules for the global trading among its member nations? Choose the most appropriate option.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) World Trade Organisation (WTO). The WTO is the international body that governs and regulates trade rules between nations on a global scale.

questions.text:
जनांकिकीय संक्रमण सिद्धांत की अवस्थाएँ

जनांकिकीय संक्रमण सिद्धांत की प्रथम अवस्था में उच्च प्रजननशीलता व उच्च मर्त्यता होती है क्योंकि लोग महामारियों और भोजन की अनिश्चित आपूर्ति से होने वाली मृत्युओं की क्षतिपूर्ति अधिक पुनरुत्पादन से करते हैं । जनसंख्या वृद्धि धीमी होती है और अधिकांश लोग खेती में कार्यरत होते हैं, जहाँ बड़े परिवारों को परिसंपत्ति माना जाता है । जीवन-प्रत्याशा निम्न होती है, अधिकांश लोग अशिक्षित होते हैं और उनके प्रौद्योगिकी स्तर निम्न होते हैं । 200 वर्ष पूर्व विश्व के सभी देश इसी अवस्था में थे ।

द्वितीय अवस्था के प्रारंभ में प्रजननशीलता ऊँची बनी रहती है किंतु यह समय के साथ घटती जाती है। यह अवस्था घटी हुई मृत्यु दर के साथ आती है। स्वास्थ्य संबंधी दशाओं व स्वच्छता में सुधार के साथ मर्त्यता में कमी आती है। इस अंतर के कारण, जनसंख्या में होने वाला शुद्ध योग उच्च होता है ।

अंतिम अवस्था में प्रजननशीलता और मर्त्यता दोनों अधिक घट जाती है। जनसंख्या या तो स्थिर हो जाती है या मंद गति से बढ़ती है । जनसंख्या नगरीय और शिक्षित हो जाती है तथा उसके पास तकनीकी ज्ञान होता है । ऐसी जनसंख्या विचारपूर्वक परिवार के आकार को नियंत्रित करती है । इससे प्रदर्शित होता है कि मनुष्य जाति अत्यधिक नम्य है और अपनी प्रजननशीलता को समायोजित करने की योग्यता रखती है । वर्तमान में विभिन्न देश जनांकिकीय संक्रमण की विभिन्न अवस्थाओं में हैं ।

15. निम्नलिखित में से किस/किन अवस्था/अवस्थाओं में जनसंख्या वृद्धि उच्च है ?
questions.text_english:
Stages of Demographic Transition Theory

The first stage of demographic transition theory has high fertility and high mortality because people reproduce more to compensate for the deaths due to epidemics and variable food supply. The population growth is slow and most of the people are engaged in agriculture, where large families are an asset. Life expectancy is low, people are mostly illiterate and have low levels of technology. Two hundred years ago, all the countries of the world were in this stage.

Fertility remains high in the beginning of second stage but it declines with time. This is accompanied by reduced mortality rate. Improvements in sanitation and health conditions lead to decline in mortality. Because of this gap, the net addition to population is high.

In the last stage, both fertility and mortality decline considerably. The population is either stable or grows slowly. The population becomes urbanized, literate and has high technical know-how and deliberately controls the family size. This shows that human beings are extremely flexible and are able to adjust their fertility. In the present day, different countries are at different stages of demographic transition.

15. Which among the following stage/stages has/have high growth of population?
questions.instruction_line: Read the passage and answer Q 15-17
questions.instruction_line_english: Read the passage and answer Q 15-17

options.C: प्रथम एवं द्वितीय दोनों अवस्थाओं में
options.D: द्वितीय एवं अंतिम दोनों अवस्थाओं में

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B). According to the passage, the second stage is characterized by high fertility but declining mortality due to improvements in health and sanitation, which results in a high net addition to the population (high growth).
questions.chapter: Population: Distribution, Density, Growth and Composition

questions.text: 16. निम्नलिखित में से जनसंख्या परिवर्तन के घटक से संबंधित सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english: 16. Choose the most appropriate option from the following regarding components of population change :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). Population change is fundamentally driven by three components: the birth rate, the death rate, and the movement of people, which is migration.

questions.text: 17. निम्नलिखित में से किस/किन अवस्था/अवस्थाओं में जनसंख्या वृद्धि धीमी रहती है ?
questions.text_english: 17. Which of the following stage/stages has/have a slow growth of population ?

options.C: केवल द्वितीय एवं अंतिम अवस्थाओं में
options.D: केवल प्रथम एवं अंतिम अवस्थाओं में

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D). The passage states that the first stage has slow population growth (high fertility countered by high mortality) and the last stage also has slow growth or stability (low fertility and low mortality).

questions.text:
18. दिए गए अनुच्छेद को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और उसके नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर लिखिए : सेवाएँ विभिन्न स्तरों पर पाई जाती हैं। कुछ सेवाएँ उद्योगों को चलाती हैं, कुछ लोगों को और कुछ उद्योगों और लोगों दोनों को, उदाहरणतः परिवहन तंत्र । सेवाएँ जैसे पंसारी की दुकानें, धोबीघाट; उच्चस्तरीय सेवाओं अथवा लेखाकार, परामर्शदाता और चिकित्सक जैसी अधिक विशिष्टीकृत सेवाओं की अपेक्षा अधिक सामान्य और विस्तृत हैं । सेवाएँ भुगतान कर सकने वाले व्यक्तिगत उपभोक्ताओं को उपलब्ध होती हैं। माली, धोबी और नाई मुख्य रूप से शारीरिक श्रम करते हैं। अध्यापक, वकील, चिकित्सक, संगीतकार और अन्य मानसिक श्रम करते हैं । अनेक सेवाएँ अब नियमित हो गई हैं। महामार्गों एवं सेतुओं का निर्माण और अनुरक्षण, अग्निशमन विभागों का अनुरक्षण और शिक्षा की पूर्ति अथवा पर्यवेक्षण और ग्राहक-सेवा महत्त्वपूर्ण सेवाओं में से हैं, जिनका पर्यवेक्षण अथवा निष्पादन प्रायः सरकारों अथवा कंपनियों द्वारा किया जाता है । राज्य और संघ विधान ने परिवहन, दूरसंचार, ऊर्जा और जलापूर्ति जैसी सेवाओं के विपणन के पर्यवेक्षण और नियंत्रण के लिए निगमों की स्थापना की है । स्वास्थ्य की देखभाल, अभियांत्रिकी, विधि और प्रबंधन व्यावसायिक सेवाएँ हैं । मनोरंजनात्मक और प्रमोद सेवाओं की स्थिति बाज़ार पर निर्भर करती है ।

(18.1) सामान्य एवं विस्तृत सेवाओं के किसी एक उदाहरण का उल्लेख कीजिए ।
(18.2) सेवाओं के विपणन का कौन पर्यवेक्षण एवं नियंत्रण करता है ?
(18.3) सेवाएँ विभिन्न स्तरों पर पाई जाती हैं । इस कथन की पुष्टि कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
18. Read the given passage carefully and answer the questions that follow: Services occur at many different levels. Some are geared to industry, some to people, and some to both industry and people, e.g., the transport systems. Services, such as grocery shops and laundries are more common and widespread than high-order services or more specialized ones like those of accountants, consultants and physicians. Services are provided to individual consumers who can afford to pay for them. For example, the gardener, the launderers and the barber do primarily physical labour. Teachers, lawyers, physicians, musicians and others perform mental labour. Many services have now been regulated. Making and maintaining highways and bridges, maintaining fire fighting departments and supplying or supervising education and customer care are among the important services most often supervised or performed by governments or companies. State and Union legislation have established corporations to supervise and control the marketing of such services as transport, telecommunication, energy and water supply. Professional services are primarily health care, engineering, law and management. The location of recreational and entertainment services depends on the market.

(18.1) Mention any one example of common and widespread services.
(18.2) Who supervises and controls the marketing of services?
(18.3) Services occur at many different levels. Confirm this statement.

sub_questions.text: सामान्य एवं विस्तृत सेवाओं के किसी एक उदाहरण का उल्लेख कीजिए ।

20. (क) विश्व व्यापार संगठन की होने वाली आलोचनाओं की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
अथवा
(ख) व्यापार संतुलन क्या है ? व्यापार संतुलन की विशेषताओं की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
20. (a) Explain the criticisms faced by the World Trade Organization.
OR
(b) What is Balance of Trade? Explain the characteristics of Balance of Trade.

key_points: Criticism: WTO favors developed countries over developing ones.
Criticism: It impacts national sovereignty.
Criticism: Focus on trade liberalization over environmental or labor standards.
Balance of Trade: Difference between the value of a country's imports and exports.
Features: Can be favorable (surplus) or unfavorable (deficit).

questions.solution: The World Trade Organization has faced criticism for allegedly favoring the interests of developed nations at the expense of developing countries. Critics also argue that its policies limit national sovereignty by overriding domestic regulations, and that its prioritize trade liberalization over essential social, labor, and environmental protections. Alternatively, Balance of Trade refers to the difference between the monetary value of a nation's exports and imports over a specific period. It is characterized as being 'favorable' when a country exports more than it imports, resulting in a surplus, or 'unfavorable' (a deficit) when import values exceed exports, directly impacting a nation's economic health.

questions.text: 21. भारत में जनसंख्या वृद्धि की प्रावस्था II की किन्हीं तीन विशेषताओं की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: 21. Explain any three characteristics of Phase II of growth of population in India.

key_points: Steady population growth.
Improved health and medical facilities reduced mortality rates.
Crude birth rate remained high.

questions.solution: Phase II of population growth in India, spanning from 1921 to 1951, is characterized by steady population growth. During this time, the overall mortality rate declined due to improvements in public health, medical facilities, and disease control measures. Simultaneously, the crude birth rate remained high, leading to a consistent increase in the total population compared to the stagnation seen in the previous phase.

22. (क) पर्यावरणीय निश्चयवाद की संकल्पना की उदाहरण सहित व्याख्या कीजिए ।
अथवा
(ख) प्रकृति और मानव के बीच द्वैतवाद वैध नहीं है । इस कथन की उदाहरण सहित व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
22. (a) Explain with example the concept of environmental determinism.
OR
(b) Duality between nature and human is not valid. Explain this statement with example.

key_points: Environmental Determinism: Nature controls human life.
Example: Tribal societies living in direct dependence on nature.
Duality not valid: Humans and nature are interdependent, not opposing forces.
Example: Sustainable development.

questions.solution: Environmental determinism posits that the physical environment is the primary force controlling human activities and societal development. An example is seen in early human societies that lived in extreme conditions and adjusted their lifestyle directly according to the climate and available resources. Alternatively, the argument that the duality between nature and human is not valid emphasizes their fundamental interdependence. Humans do not exist in opposition to nature but as part of it, shaping and being shaped by it. Sustainable development, where humans manage resources responsibly to maintain ecological balance, demonstrates that human actions and natural processes are inextricably linked, rendering the idea of a strict duality false.

questions.text: 23. भारत में मलिन बस्तियों (slums) की किन्हीं तीन समस्याओं की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: 23. Explain any three problems of slums in India.

key_points: Poor sanitation and hygiene.
Overcrowding and inadequate housing.
Lack of basic amenities like clean water.

questions.solution: Slums in India face severe challenges, primarily poor sanitation and hygiene, which lead to the rapid spread of diseases. Overcrowding is another major issue, as a large number of people reside in very small, fragile dwellings, resulting in inadequate living space. Furthermore, there is a persistent lack of basic amenities, such as access to clean drinking water, electricity, and proper waste management systems, which significantly lowers the quality of life.

questions.text: 24. मानव विकास सूचकांक का किस प्रकार मापन किया जाता है ? मानव विकास के महत्वपूर्ण सूचकों की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: 24. How is the Human Development Index measured? Explain the key indicators of human development.

key_points: Measurement: Based on values from 0 to 1.
Three dimensions: Health, Education, Standard of Living.
Indicator 1: Life expectancy at birth (Health).
Indicator 2: Adult literacy and school enrollment (Education).
Indicator 3: Purchasing power parity or per capita income (Standard of Living).

questions.solution: The Human Development Index (HDI) is a composite statistical index that measures a country's overall achievement in its social and economic dimensions, with values ranging from 0 to 1. It is measured using three core indicators. First, health is assessed through life expectancy at birth, indicating the longevity of the population. Second, education is measured through adult literacy rates and gross school enrollment ratios, reflecting access to knowledge. Third, the standard of living is assessed via per capita gross national income, adjusted for purchasing power parity. These three dimensions collectively provide a more comprehensive view of human development than traditional economic metrics alone.

questions.text_english:
25. (a) Explain the main features of the Atlantic Ocean.
OR
(b) Explain the main features of the Rhine Waterways.

key_points: Atlantic: Major commercial route connecting Europe/Africa to Americas.
Atlantic: Busy ports, handles large volumes of international trade.
Rhine: Most heavily used inland waterway in Europe.
Rhine: Connects industrial regions of Germany with major ports like Rotterdam.

questions.solution: The Atlantic Ocean serves as the world's most significant commercial route, connecting the major industrial economies of Europe and Africa with the Americas. It handles a massive volume of international maritime trade, supported by a network of highly developed ports along both sides. Alternatively, the Rhine waterway is considered the most heavily used inland navigable river in Europe. It serves as a vital economic artery, connecting the industrial heartlands of Germany, France, and Switzerland with the Port of Rotterdam in the Netherlands, facilitating the efficient transport of bulk goods, raw materials, and finished industrial products across the continent.

26. (क) विश्व में रोपण कृषि की प्रमुख विशेषताओं का विश्लेषण कीजिए ।
अथवा
(ख) विश्व में विस्तृत वाणिज्य अनाज कृषि की प्रमुख विशेषताओं का विश्लेषण कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
26. (a) Analyze the main features of Plantation Agriculture in the world.
OR
(b) Analyze the main features of Extensive Commercial Grain Farming in the world.

key_points: Plantation: Large-scale, monoculture, cash crops like tea/coffee.
Plantation: High capital investment, skilled management, export-oriented.
Extensive: Large landholdings, low labor, highly mechanized.
Extensive: Geared towards production of wheat/grains in sparsely populated areas.

questions.solution: Plantation agriculture is characterized by large-scale farming focusing on a single cash crop, such as tea, coffee, rubber, or sugarcane. It requires high capital investment, sophisticated management, and specialized technical knowledge. These farms are typically export-oriented and rely on a large, disciplined labor force. Conversely, extensive commercial grain farming is practiced on very large landholdings in sparsely populated areas of mid-latitudes, such as the North American prairies. It is highly mechanized, requiring very little labor per hectare, and is almost exclusively focused on the production of grains like wheat for international commercial markets.

questions.text: 27. अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार के प्रवेश द्वार के रूप में भारतीय समुद्री पत्तनों की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: 27. Explain Indian sea ports as gateways of international trade.

key_points: Gateways: Handle the vast majority of India's foreign trade by volume.
Role: Connect domestic markets with global supply chains.
Strategic: Ports like Mumbai, Kandla, and Chennai handle diversified cargo.
Function: Essential for import of fuel, technology, and export of manufactured goods.

questions.solution: Indian sea ports act as vital gateways for international trade, as they handle the vast majority of India's foreign trade by volume. These ports serve as critical nodes that connect domestic manufacturing and agricultural markets with global supply chains. Strategically located along India's extensive coastline, major ports like Mumbai, Kandla, and Chennai facilitate the import of essential resources such as fuel and advanced technology, while simultaneously enabling the export of manufactured goods and agricultural products to international markets. They are fundamental to India's economic growth and integration into the global economy.

28. (क) भारत में खनिज संसाधनों के संरक्षण और सतत पोषणीय विकास के संबंध का विश्लेषण कीजिए ।
अथवा
(ख) भारत में सौर ऊर्जा का उदाहरण देकर ऊर्जा के अपारंपरिक स्रोतों के लाभों की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
28. (a) Analyze the relationship between conservation of mineral resources and sustainable development in India.
OR
(b) Explain the benefits of non-conventional sources of energy by giving an example of solar energy in India.

key_points: Conservation: Efficient mining, reducing waste, recycling.
Sustainability: Balancing current needs with future requirements.
Non-conventional: Renewable, environmentally friendly.
Solar Energy: Abundant, reduces dependence on fossil fuels, sustainable.

questions.solution: The conservation of mineral resources is inextricably linked to the goal of sustainable development in India. Because mineral deposits are finite and non-renewable, efficient extraction techniques, the reduction of waste during mining, and the recycling of used metals are essential to ensure these resources remain available for future generations without compromising current development. Alternatively, non-conventional energy sources, such as solar power, offer substantial benefits. Solar energy is abundant, renewable, and environmentally friendly, drastically reducing dependence on finite and polluting fossil fuels. By expanding its solar energy capacity, India can meet its growing power demands in a sustainable and ecologically responsible manner.
